title: Unit 8 Consolidation
goal: Review the connectors of concession and counter-argument and read a short text about Alejo Carpentier and his novel El reino de este mundo.

items: Review aunque, si bien, por más que and aun cuando with the indicative and the subjunctive.
Review the repeated subjunctive of pase lo que pase.
Read a text about the writer Alejo Carpentier and his novel.
I can concede a point and keep my position with aunque, si bien, por más que and aun cuando.
I can choose between the indicative for a fact and the subjunctive for a possibility after a concessive connector.
I can say that nothing changes my decision with formulas such as pase lo que pase.
I can read a short text about Carpentier and his novel El reino de este mundo.
